summary:
Iteration 68 — PURE REGRESSION TEST after the big draw.tsx refactor (10,387 → 2,429 lines, UI pieces moved into /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/*, logic moved into /app/frontend/src/sketch/editor/*). Tested frontend only on the public preview URL at 768x1024 and 390x844. Editor loads cleanly — zero PAGEERROR, zero CONSOLE[error] (only the pre-existing benign dev-only warning 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' is observed, identical to iterations 64-67 and pre-refactor). All exercised sketch-editor flows behave exactly as before. No refactor-related 'X is not defined / Cannot read properties of undefined / undefined is not a function' errors were observed.

Flows verified live in the browser:
1) Editor loads at /sketches/draw?projectId=p1, toolbar + canvas + 'Elemente: 0' overlay + sketch-save-button testID present. Tour overlay dismissal via 'Überspringen' works. (768x1024 + 390x844).
2) Pen tool → drag → Elemente becomes 1 (stroke rendered as path).
3) Rectangle tool → drag → Elemente 2.
4) Circle tool → drag → Elemente 3.
5) Line tool → opens LineTypePickerModal (title 'Linientyp wählen') with the three options 'Linie', 'Pfeil', 'Doppelpfeil' (all rendered as expected).
6) Polygon tool → tap 4 points + tap first point to close → Elemente +1 (single polygon element). PolylineControls panel appears while drawing.
7) Text tool → tap canvas → TextModal 'Text eingeben' opens with input, font-size slider (- / +), font tabs (Standard / Handschrift / Monospace / Serif), colour swatches, Cancel + Add. Typing + Add → element added and 'TEST_TEXT' is visible on canvas.
8) Notiz/Memo tool → tap canvas → MemoModal 'Notiz hinzufügen' opens with text input + numpad-icon toggle + Cancel/Add. Modal is dismissible with Cancel.
9) Measure Line (M) tool → drag → ArrowModal opens with built-in numpad; typing '2,50' on physical keyboard writes to the BufferedTextInput and Add inserts a dashed-arrow measurement element with the label visible on canvas; selected element shows 'Elemente: 3 / Ausgewählt' info overlay.
10) Save: sketch-save-button saves to localStorage key 'aufmassprofi_sketches' with full structure {project_id, title, notes, sketch_data (SVG preview as data-URL), pdf_size, id, created_at, updated_at}. SVG preview correctly renders the polygon ('<path d="M 250 155 L 550 155 ... Z"').
11) Reopen: navigating back to /sketches/draw?projectId=p1&sketchId=<id> restores Elemente=1 and sets the title input to 'TEST_PersistSketch' (loadSketch path works after refactor).
12) Edit tool → tap polygon → 'Ausgewählt' label appears in the info overlay, transform handles rendered (renderTransformHandles path).
13) Tap polygon side in Edit mode → LineMeasurePanel opens with testID 'line-measure-scroll' present; header 'Enter measurement', progress 'Linie 1 von 4 · 4 offen', 'Mehr' and 'Tastatur' toggles (panel-options-toggle / panel-keyboard-toggle), S/M/L + ABC + numpad grid + Cancel/Done buttons all rendered exactly as in iter-67. Entering a measurement (e.g. 4,00m) populates the first side, a '4,00m' label appears above the polygon, SketchLegend 'Overview / S1 = 4 lfm' panel appears bottom-right ('Übersicht' flow intact).
14) Grid button toggles grid rendering; Undo/Redo testIDs sketch-undo-button + sketch-redo-button present.

Not exercised live in this iteration (no refactor-related smoke found in code review of those paths — main agent can spot-check):
- Full 4-side polygon area computation to m² (only first side entered; the 'Done' label of the Add button was not clicked in my script — the panel itself opens and advances correctly, so this is a scripting gap, not a product bug).
- +Pt / -Pt live.
- Protractor overlay drag (tool button visible but was off-screen on 390x844 without scrolling; on 768x1024 Angle button opens the mode but was not interacted with).
- DeleteConfirmModal / ElementStylePanel / EditTextModal / EditArrowModal / EditMemoModal / EditPointerModal / EditPolygonModal (modals present in /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/, imports in draw.tsx resolve, no undefined refs found by code review).
- CropModal / ProjectPhotosModal (web file-chooser gated).
- Bluetooth laser / native contacts (web preview cannot test).

Code-review highlights (refactor quality):
- draw.tsx is 2,429 lines; expected imports from both sub-folders present; every modal and panel listed in the problem statement is a file under /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/ (SketchHeader, SavingOverlay, SketchToolbar, ColorPickerPanel, ElementStylePanel, GridSettingsPanel, CanvasInfoOverlay, PolylineControls, SketchLegend, LineMeasurePanel + MeasurePanelOptions/MeasureLineStyleSection/MeasurePanelKeyboard, TextModal, ArrowModal, EditArrowModal, PointerModal, EditPointerModal, MemoModal, EditMemoModal, NotesModal, EditPolygonModal, EditTextModal, LineTypePickerModal, ProjectPhotosModal, CropModal, DeleteConfirmModal, MagnifierOverlay, ProtractorOverlay, InModalNumpad, renderSketchElement, renderTransformHandles — all 30 verified present). /app/frontend/src/sketch/editor/ contains the 7 logic modules (touchHandlers, hitTest, persistence, images, lineMeasurements, protractor, elementActions) — all present.
- No 'X is not defined' / 'Cannot read properties of undefined' / 'undefined is not a function' observed during the exercised flows, including focused ref flows (BufferedTextInput in ArrowModal + LineMeasurePanel) and PanResponder flows (polygon drag + rectangle drag).

action_items: (No refactor-related defects found.) Suggested follow-ups (carry-over, not new): add explicit testIDs for the LineMeasurePanel Cancel/Done buttons (line-measure-cancel-button / line-measure-done-button) and for toolbar items (polyline-tool-button / arrow-tool-button / pen-tool-button / rectangle-tool-button / circle-tool-button / edit-tool-button / angle-tool-button) so automation does not have to rely on label text (which is also truncated on narrow viewports: 'M...' instead of 'Memo').
critical_code_review_comments: draw.tsx now 2,429 lines (was 10,387). All 30 UI sub-components referenced in the review request are present under /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/draw/ and all 7 logic modules are present under /app/frontend/src/sketch/editor/.

No runtime errors observed in Pen/Rectangle/Circle/Line/Polygon/Text/Memo/Measure-line/Save/Reopen/Edit-tap/LineMeasurePanel-open flows — including the focus-ref flows (BufferedTextInput in ArrowModal + LineMeasurePanel) and the PanResponder flows (polygon drag, rectangle drag).

Save→reload round-trip works: localStorage 'aufmassprofi_sketches' contains {project_id, title, notes, sketch_data (SVG data-URL), pdf_size, id, created_at, updated_at}; reopen with ?sketchId= restores title + element count. SVG preview correctly contains the polygon path (no crash in the preview generator).

success_rate.frontend: Live-verified flows: 14/14 pass (editor load, Pen, Rectangle, Circle, Line type picker, Polygon, Text modal, Memo modal, Measure arrow modal, Save, Reopen, Edit select, LineMeasurePanel open, first side measurement + legend). Zero runtime errors.

seed_data_creation: Only transient localStorage keys (aufmassprofi_settings, aufmassprofi_customers=[cust1/TEST_Max Muster], aufmassprofi_projects=[p1/TEST_Projekt], aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked, aufmassprofi_tour_done, aufmassprofi_sketch_tour_done). A single TEST_PersistSketch was written to aufmassprofi_sketches and remains only in the test browser context — no shared storage touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor-regression run complete and clean. Toolbar labels used to drive the test (works well on 768x1024): 'Pen', 'Rectangle', 'Circle', 'Line', 'Polygon', 'Text', 'Notiz', 'Measure Line', 'Grid', 'Angle', 'Edit'. The LineMeasurePanel Add button is labelled 'Done' (not 'Add' / 'Hinzufügen') — important for scripting the 4-side polygon area assertion. On 390x844 the toolbar is horizontally scrollable: Pen / Line / Circle / Rectangle / Angle / Measure Line are off-screen and need to be scrolled into view (reuse SCROLL_JS helper from /app/tests/e2e/setup_snippet.py). To exercise the full polygon→m² flow: Polygon(4 corners + close) → Edit → tap each side in sequence → type + click 'Done' 4 times → verify an 'X,XX m²' label appears inside the polygon and SketchLegend shows the area.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no regression found. The mechanical AST-based refactor preserved runtime behaviour for every flow exercised in this run; no missing props, no stale refs, no broken PanResponders, no missing imports, no crashed modals.
